newFileContributions.change: Implement normative approvals commands on the accepted common gateway/store. Pin definitionVersion and form snapshot/digest at start, preserve authorized source refs/audience, return instanceRef/currentNode/receipt. decide accepts instance/node/formVersion/baseRevision/nodeVersion/decision/reason/previewHash/commandId, derives actor from transport, validates current eligibility/grants/policy and preview digest, and commits decision, quorum advance, effect intent and outbox together. Use unique(instance,node,actor,decisionGeneration), command-id dedup and guarded revision advancement; duplicate retry returns the original receipt. Implement reasoned reject/return, policy-limited delegation with purpose/expiry/cycle checks, and cancellation audit without deleting history. read/list are query-only, including when called by MCP/agents. Symbol names are proposed, not existing exports.

Consume durable eligible effect intents via shared journal/outbox worker. Recheck current target/provider scopes and preview-bound arguments/source/audience/policy at dispatch; approval authority is not target.write. Record blocked/queued/accepted/readback/failed/unknown distinctly. Use stable idempotency key and dedup providerEventId; persist receipts before projecting outcomes. Resolve duplicate/out-of-order callbacks by existing effect state/journal, never regress readback or resend an unknown outcome blindly. Reconcile provider state with finite recovery and append immutable audit events. Provider work is async outside the DB transaction. Exact adapter/worker imports await lead receipts.

Register with the canonical migration runner. Persist workspace/entity/versionRef/targetRef/formDigest/snapshot/state/revision and route generations; decisions uniquely constrained by instance/node/actor/decisionGeneration; delegation purpose/expiry lineage; effects with durable idempotency key. Bind command dedup, immutable audit and callback providerEventId uniqueness to common receipt/journal/outbox tables instead of inventing a second audit/effect store. Transactionally support quorum CAS and outbox, aliases and reload. Exact foreign keys/alias names depend on accepted canonical schema.

Render canonical instanceRef, pinned snapshot/source links, route timeline/quorum/current node, submission review with Cmd+Enter, effect preview, reasoned explicit Approve/Reject/Return, eligible-principal Delegate and audit/receipt tab. Show immutable domain decision independently from execution outcome; never show completed for blocked/unknown effects. Preserve drafts across navigation/error/conflict/timeout under workspace/purpose/current grants; no success before receipt. Reuse tokens/fonts/native controls, accessible help and narrow drilldown; query/open/read/selection/help never decides. Unsupported capability is honestly disabled with reason.

Exercise real persisted commands and renderer/API/MCP equivalents using deterministic synthetic principals and a controlled provider adapter with meaningful receipt/readback/failure oracles. Cover all six normative tests and the complete user journey/reload, transport actor spoof, revoke/replay, delegation expiry/cycles, source-audience non-expansion, projection retraction and adjacent permission/credential/mail flows. Retain green baseline and seeded-mutant intended-assertion evidence; mocks/render-only success do not prove feature completion.
